verses.sanskrit:
वैशम्पायन उवाच।
              विसृष्टास्वथ नारीषु धृतराष्ट्रोऽम्बिकासुतः। विललाप महाराज दुःखाद् दुःखान्तरं गतः॥१॥
verses.english: Vaishampayana said After the ladies had been sent away, Dhritarashtra, the son of Ambika, sunk into grief greater than that which had afflicted him before, began, O monarch, to bewail.

verses.sanskrit: सधूममिव निःश्वस्य करौ धुन्वन्पुनः पुनः। विचिन्त्य च महाराज वचनं चेदमब्रवीत्॥२॥
verses.english: Exhaling smoky breaths and repeatedly shaking his arms and reflecting a little, O monarch, he said these words.

verses.sanskrit:
धृतराष्ट्र उवाच।
              अहो बत महद्दुःखं यदहं पाण्डवान् रणे। क्षेमिणश्चाव्ययांश्चैव त्वत्तः सूत शृणोमि वै॥३॥
verses.english: Dhritarashtra said Alas, O Suta, painful is the news that I hear from you viz., that the Pandavas are all safe and have suffered no loss in battle!

verses.sanskrit: वज्रसारमयं नूनं हृदयं सुदृढं मम। यच्छ्रुत्वा निहतान्पुत्रान् दीर्यते न सहस्रधा॥४॥
verses.bhavadeepa: पाण्डवाः क्षेमिण इत्येकं दुःखं स्वीयाश्च सर्वे निहता इत्यपरं ते द्वे आह द्वाभ्याम् अहो इति॥३॥

verses.sanskrit: चिन्तयित्वा वयस्तेषां बालक्रीडां च सञ्जय। हतान्पुत्रानशेषेण दीर्यते मे भृशं मनः॥५॥
verses.english: Thinking of their ages, O Sanjaya and of their sports in childhood and learning today that all of them have died, my heart seems to break into pieces!

verses.sanskrit: अनेत्रत्वाद्यदेतेषां न मे रूपनिदर्शनम्। पुत्रस्नेहकृता प्रीतिर्नित्यमेतेषु धारिता॥६॥
verses.english: Although owing to my blindness I never saw their forms, still I cherished a great love for them on account of the affection one feels for his children.

verses.sanskrit: बालभावमतिक्रम्य यौवनस्थांश्च तानहम्। मध्यप्राप्तांस्तथा श्रुत्वा हृष्ट आसं तदानघ॥७॥
verses.english: Hearing that they had passed out of childhood and entered the period of youth and then of early manhood, I became highly glad, Osinless one.

verses.sanskrit: तानद्य निहताञ्श्रुत्वा हतैश्वर्यान् हतौजसः। न लभेयं क्वचिच्छान्तिं पुत्राधिभिरभिप्लुतः॥८॥
verses.english: Hearing today that they have been killed and divested of prosperity and energy, I do not enjoy peace of mind, being overwhelmed with grief on account of the calamity that has befallen them.

verses.sanskrit: एह्येहि पुत्र राजेन्द्र ममानाथस्य साम्प्रतम्। त्वया हीनो महाबाहो कां नु यास्याम्यहं गतिम्॥९॥
verses.english: Come, come, O king of kings, to me that am without a lord now! Deprived of you, O mighty-armed one, what will be my condition?

verses.sanskrit: कथं त्वं पृथिवीपालांस्त्यक्त्वा तात समागतान्। शेषे विनिहतो भूमौ प्राकृतः कुनृपो यथा॥१०॥
verses.english: Why, O sire, leaving all the assembled kings do you lie on the nacked ground, deprived of life, like an ordinary and wretched king?

verses.sanskrit: गतिर्भूत्वा महाराज ज्ञातीनां सुहृदां तथा। अन्धं वृद्धं च मां वीर विहाय क्व नु यास्यसि॥११॥
verses.english: Having been, O monarch, the refuge of kinsmen and friends, where do you go now, O hero, leaving me that am blind and old?
verses.bhavadeepa: प्राकृतो नीचः। कुनृपः कुत्सितान्नरान्पातीति नीचपरिजन इत्यर्थः॥१०॥

verses.sanskrit: सा कृपा सा च ते प्रीतिः सा राजन्सुमानिता। कथं विनिहतः पार्थैः संयुगेष्वपराजितः॥१२॥
को नु मामुत्थितं वीर तात तातेति वक्ष्यति। महाराजेति सततं लोकनाथेति तासकृत्॥१३॥
verses.english: Who will now, after I will get up from bed at the proper hour, repeatedly address me in such loving and respectful words as-O father, O father-O great king-O Lord of the world!-and affectionately clasping my neck with tearful eyes, will ask for my orders, saying-Command me, you of Kuru's race!-address me, O son, in that sweet language once inore!

verses.sanskrit: परिष्वज्य च मां कण्ठे स्नेहेन किन्नलोचनः। अनुशाधीति कौरव्य तत्साधु वद मे वचः॥१४॥
ननु नामाहमश्रौषं वचनं तव पुत्रक। भूयसी मम पृथ्वीयं यथा पार्थस्य नो तथा॥१५॥
verses.bhavadeepa: तत्परागुक्तं साधु यथा स्यात्तथा मे मां प्रति वद पुनरिति शेषः॥१४॥

verses.sanskrit: भगदत्तः कृपः शल्य आवन्त्योऽथ जयद्रथः। भूरिश्रवाः सोमदत्तो महाराजश्च बाह्निकः॥१६॥
verses.english: Bhagadatta and Kripa and Shalya and the two princes of Avanti and Jayadratha and Bhurishravas and Cala and Somadatta and Valhika and Ashvatthaman and the chief of the Bhojas and the mighty princes of Magadha and Vrihadvala and the ruler of the Kasis and Shakuni, the son son of Subala and many thousands of Mlechchhas and Shakas and Yavanas and Sudakshina the ruler of the Kambojas and the king of the Trigartas and the grandsire Bhishma and Bharadvaja's son and Gotama's son and Shrutayusha and Ayutayusha and Shatayusha of great power and Jalasandha and Rishyashringa's son and the Rakshasa Alayudha and the mighty-arined Alambusha and the great car-warrior Suvahu-these and many other kings, O best of monarchs, have taken up arms on my behalf and are ready to throw away their very lives in great battle!

verses.sanskrit: अश्वत्थामा च भोजश्च मागधश्च महाबलः। बृहद्वलश्च काशीशः शकुनिश्चापि सौबलः॥१७॥
म्लेच्छश्च शतसाहस्राः शकाश्चः यवनैः सह। सुदक्षिणश्च काम्बोजस्त्रिगर्ताधिपतिस्तथा॥१८॥
भीष्मः पितामहश्चैव भारद्वाजोऽथ गौतमः। श्रुतायुश्चायुतायुश्च शतायुश्चापि वीर्यवान्॥१९॥
जलसन्धोऽथार्ष्यशृङ्गी राक्षसश्चाप्यलायुधः। अलम्बुषो महाबाहुः सुबाहुश्च महारथः॥२०॥
एते चान्ये च बहवो राजानो राजसत्तम। मदर्थमुद्यताः सर्वे प्राणांस्त्यक्त्वा धनानि च॥२१॥
तेषां मध्ये स्थितो युद्धे भ्रातृभिः परिवारितः। योधयिष्याम्यहं पार्थान्पञ्चालांश्चैव सर्वशः॥२२॥
verses.english: Stationed on the field amidst these and encircled by my brothers, I will fight against all the Parthas and the Panchalas and the Chedis, O foremost to kings and the son of Draupadi and Satyaki and Kuntibhoja and the Rakshasa Ghatotkacha.

verses.sanskrit: चेदींश्च नृपशार्दूल द्रौपदेयांश्च संयुगे। सात्यकिं कुन्तिभोजं च राक्षसं च घटोत्कचम्॥२३॥
एकोऽप्येषां महाराज समर्थः सन्निवारणे। समरे पाण्डवेयानां सङ्क्रुद्धो ह्यभिधावताम्॥२४॥
verses.english: Even one amongst these, O king, worked up with anger, is able to resist in battle the Pandavas rushing towards him!

verses.sanskrit: किं पुनः सहिता वीराः कृतवैराश्च पाण्डवैः। अथवा सर्व एवैते पाण्डवस्यानुयायिभिः॥२५॥
verses.english: What need I say then of all these heroes, every one of whom has wrongs to avenge on the Pandavas, when united together? All these, O monarch, will fight with the followers of the Pandavas and will kill them in battle.

verses.sanskrit: योत्स्यन्ते सह राजेन्द्र हनिष्यन्ति च तान् मृघे। कर्ण एको मया सार्धं निहनिष्यति पाण्डवान्॥२६॥
verses.english: Karna alone, with myself, will kill the Pandavas. All the heroic kings will then live under my control.

verses.sanskrit: ततो नृपतयो वीराः स्थास्यन्ति मम शासने। यश्च तेषां प्रणेता वै वासुदेवो महाबलः॥२७॥
verses.english: Their leader, the mighty Vasudeva, will not, he has told me, take up arms for them, O king. In this way, O Suta, did Duryodhana often use to speak to me. Hearing what he said, I believed that the Pandavas would be killed in battle.

verses.sanskrit: न स सन्नह्यते राजन्निति मामब्रवीद्वचः। तस्याथ वदतः सूत बहुशो मम सन्निधौ॥२८॥
शक्तितो ह्यनुपश्यामि निहतान्पाण्डवान् रणे। तेषां मध्ये स्थिता यत्र हन्यन्ते मम पुत्रकाः॥२९॥
verses.english: While, my sons, stationed in the midst of those heroes and fighting vigorously in battle, have all been slain, what can it be but Destiny?

verses.sanskrit: व्यायच्छमानाः समरे किमन्यद्भागधेयतः। भीष्मश्च निहतो यत्र लोकनाथः प्रतापवान्॥३०॥
verses.english: When that lord of the world, viz., the valiant Bhishma, having encountered Shikhandin, died like a lion, killed by a jackal, what can it be but Destiny?

verses.sanskrit: शिखण्डिनं समासाद्य मृगेन्द्र इव जम्बुकम्। द्रोणश्च ब्राह्मणो यत्र सर्वशस्त्रास्त्रपारगः॥३१॥
verses.english: When the Brahmana Drona, the master of all offensive and defensive, weapons has been killed by the Pandavas in battle, what can it be but Destiny?

verses.sanskrit: निहतः पाण्डवैः सङ्ख्ये किमन्यद्भागधेयतः। कर्णश्च निहतं सङ्ख्ये दिव्यास्त्रज्ञो महाबलः॥३२॥
verses.english: When Bhurishravas has been slain in battle, as also Somadatta and king Valhika, what can it be else Destiny?

verses.sanskrit: भूरिश्रवा हतो यत्र सोमदत्तश्च संयुगे। बाह्लिकश्च महाराज किमन्यद्भागधेयतः॥३३॥
verses.english: When Bhagadatta, an expert in fighting from the back of elephants, has been killed and when Jayadratha has been slain, what can it be but Fate?

verses.sanskrit: भगदत्तो हतो यत्र गजयुद्धविशारदः। जयद्रथश्च निहतः किमन्यद्भादधेयतः॥३४॥
verses.english: When Sudakshina has been slain and Jalasandha of Puru's race, as also Shrutayusha and Ayutayusha, what can it be but Destiny?

verses.sanskrit: सुदक्षिणो हतो यत्र जलसन्धश्च पौरवः। श्रुतायुश्चायुतायुश्च किमन्यद्भागधेयतः॥३५॥
महाबलस्तथा पाण्डयः सर्वशस्त्रभृतां वरः। निहतः पाण्डवैः सङ्ख्ये किमन्यद्भागधेयतः॥३६॥
verses.english: When Brihadvala has been slain and the powerful king of the Magadhas and the brave Ugrayudha, that model of all bowmen when the two princes of Avanti viz., Vinda and Avinda have been slain, and the king also of thc Trigartas, as also the numerous Samshaptakas, what can it be but Destiny?

verses.sanskrit: बृहद्बलो हतो यत्र मागधश्च महाबलः। उग्रायुधश्च विक्रान्तः प्रतिमानं धनुष्मताम्॥३७॥
आवन्त्यो निहतो यत्र त्रैगर्तश्च जनाधिपः। संशप्तकाश्च निहताः किमन्यद्भागधेयतः॥३८॥
अलम्बुषस्तथा राजन् राक्षसश्चाप्यलायुधः। आर्ष्यशृङ्गिश्च निहतः किमन्यद्भागधेयतः॥३९॥
verses.english: When king Alambusha and the Rakshasa Alayudha and Rishyashringa's on have been slain, what can it be but Destiny.

verses.sanskrit: नारायणा हता यत्र गोपाला युद्धदुर्मदाः। म्लेच्छाश्च बहुसाहस्राः किमन्यद्भागधेयतः॥४०॥
शकुनिः सौबलो यत्र कैतव्यश्च महाबलः। निहतः सबलो वीरः किमन्यद्भागधेयतः॥४१॥
verses.english: When Shakuni the son of Subala and the powerful Uluka, called the gamester's son, at the head of his forces, have been slain, what can it be but Destiny?

verses.sanskrit: एते चान्ये च बहवः कृतास्त्रा युद्धदुर्मदाः। राजानो राजपुत्राश्च शूराः परिघबाहवः॥४२॥
verses.english: When numerous great heroes, well-read in all sorts of offensive and defensive weapons and gifted with prowess equal to that of Indra himself, have been slain, ( Suta, when Kshatriyas coming from different kingdoms, O Sanjaya, have all been slain in battle, what can it be but Destiny?

verses.sanskrit: निहता बहवो यत्र किमन्यद्भागधेयतः। यत्र शूरा महेष्वासाः कृतास्त्रा युद्धदुर्मदाः॥४३॥
बहवो निहताः सूत महेन्द्रसमविक्रमाः। नानादेशसमावृत्ताः क्षत्रिया यत्र सञ्जय॥४४॥
निहताः समरे सर्वे किमन्यद्भागधेयतः। पुत्राश्च मे विनिहताः पौत्राश्चैव महाबलाः॥४५॥
वयस्या भ्रातरश्चैव किमन्यद्भागधेयतः। भागधेयसमायुक्तो ध्रुवमुत्पद्यते नरः॥४६॥
verses.english: My mighty, sons and grandsons have been slain, as also my friends and brothers, what can it be but Destiny? Truly man takes his birth, subject to Destiny.

verses.sanskrit: यस्तु भाग्यसमायुक्तः स शुभं प्राप्नुयान्नरः। अहं वियुक्तस्तैर्भाग्यैः पुत्रैश्चैवेह सञ्जय॥४७॥
verses.english: A fortunate man always meets with good. I am bereft of good fortune and therefore, am deprived of my children, O Sanjaya. Old as I am, how shall I now submit to the sway of enemies? I do not think anything else but exile into the woods is good for me, O lord. Shorn of relatives and kinsmen as I am, I will go into the woods.

verses.sanskrit: कथमद्य भविष्यामि वृद्धः शत्रुवशं गतः। नान्यदत्र परं मन्ये वनवासादृते प्रभो॥४८॥
सोऽहं वनं गमिष्यामि निर्बन्धुर्ज्ञातिसंक्षये। न हि मेऽन्यद्भवेच्छ्रेयो वनाभ्युपगमादृते॥४९॥
इमामवस्थां प्राप्तस्य लूनपक्षस्य सञ्जय। दुर्योधनो हतो यत्र शल्यश्च निहतो युधि॥५०॥
verses.english: Nothing else save an exile into the woods can be better for me who am fallen into this plight and who am shorn of my sons, O Sanjaya.

verses.sanskrit: दुःशासनो विविंशश्च विकर्णश्च महाबलः। कथं हि भीमसेनस्य श्रोष्येऽहं शब्दमुत्तमम्॥५१॥
verses.english: When Duryodhana has been slain, Shalya also has been slain in battle, when Dusshasana and Vivingsha and the mighty Vikarna have been slain, how shall I be able to bear the shouts of that Bhimasena who has alone killed a hundred sons of inine in battle?

verses.sanskrit: एकेन समरे येन हतं पुत्रशतं मम। असकृद्वदतस्तस्य दुर्योधनवधेन च॥५२॥

दुःखशोकाभिसन्तप्तो न श्रोष्ये परुषा गिरः।
              वैशम्पायन उवाच।
              एवं वृद्धश्च सन्तप्तः पार्थिवो हतबान्धवः॥५३॥
verses.english: He will frequently speak of the slaughter of Duryodhana in my ears. Burning with grief and sorrow, I shall not be able to withstand his cruel words!"

verses.sanskrit: मुहुर्मुहुर्मुह्यमानः पुत्रादिभिरभिप्लुतः। विलप्य सुचिरं कालं धृतराष्ट्रोऽम्बिकासुतः॥५४॥
verses.english: Vaishampayana said Even thus that king burning with grief and deprived of relatives and kinsmen, repeatedly swooned, overwhelmed with grief consequent on the death of his sons.

verses.sanskrit: दीर्घमुष्णं स निःश्वस्य चिन्तयित्वा पराभवम्। दुःखेन महता राजन्सन्तप्तो भरतर्षभः॥५५॥
verses.english: Having wept for a long time, Dhritarashtra, the son of Ambika, sighted heavily thinking of his defeat.

verses.sanskrit:
पुनर्गावल्गणिं सूतं पर्यपृच्छद्यथातथम्।
              धृतराष्ट्र उवाच।
              भीष्मद्रौणौ हतौ श्रुत्वा सूतपुत्रं च घातितम्॥५६॥
verses.english: Overwhelined with sorrow and burning with grief, that best of Bharata's race once more enquired of his charioteer Sanjaya, the son of Gavalgana, the details of the battle.

verses.sanskrit: सेनापतिं प्रणेतारं किमकुर्वत मामकाः। यं यं सेनाप्रणेतारं युधि कुर्वन्ति मामकाः॥५७॥
verses.english: Dhritarashtra said After Bhishma and Drona had been slain and the Suta's son also overthrown, whom did my warriors make their general?

verses.sanskrit: अचिरेणैव कालेन तं तं निघ्नन्ति पाण्डवाः। रणमूर्ध्नि हतो भीष्मः पश्यतां वः किरीटिना॥५८॥
verses.english: The Pandavas are slaying quickly every one whom my warriors make their general in battle.

verses.sanskrit: एवमेव हतो द्रोणः सर्वेषामेव पश्यताम्। एवमेव हतः कर्णः सूतपुत्रः प्रतापवान्॥५९॥
verses.english: Bhishma was slain at the van of battle by the diadem-decked Arjuna in your presence. Even thus was Drona slain before you all.

verses.sanskrit: स राजकानां सर्वेषां पश्यतां वः किरीटिना। पूर्वमेवाहमुक्तो वै विदुरेण महात्मना॥६०॥
verses.english: Even thus was the Suta's son, the valiant Karna, slain by Arjuna in the presence of all the kings.

verses.sanskrit: दुर्योधनापराधेन प्रजेयं विनशिष्यति। केचिन्न सम्यक्पश्यन्ति मूढाः सम्यगवेक्ष्य च। तदिदं मम मूढस्य तथाभूतं वचः स्म तत्॥६१॥
verses.english: There are some fools that do not see things even though they cașt their eyes on them. Those words of Vidura have proved true in my case.

verses.sanskrit: यदब्रवीत् स धर्मात्मा विदुरो दीर्घदर्शिवान्। तत्तथा समनुप्राप्तं वचनं सत्यवादिनः॥६२॥
verses.english: What the pious Vidura, conversant with the attributes of everything, then said, had proved true, for the words he uttered were nothing but the truth.
verses.bhavadeepa: सम्यगवेक्ष्य निपुणं विभाव्यापि मूढास्तथाभूतं तद्वचः केचिन्न पश्यन्तीत्युत्तरेण सम्बन्धः॥६१॥

verses.sanskrit: दैवोपहतचित्तेन यन्मया न कृतं पुरा। अनयस्य फलं तस्य ब्रूहि गावल्गणे पुनः॥६४॥
verses.english: Afflicted by fate, I did not then act according to those words. The fruits of that evil course have now appeared. Describe them to me, O son of Gavalgana, once more.

verses.sanskrit: को वा मुखमनीकानामासीत्कर्णे निपातिते। अर्जुनं वासुदेवं च को वा प्रत्युद्ययौ रथी॥६५॥
verses.english: Who became the head of our army after Karna's fall? Who was that car-warrior who proceeded against Arjuna and Vasudeva?

verses.sanskrit: केऽरक्षन् दक्षिणं चक्रं मद्रराजस्य संयुगे। वामं च योद्धुकामस्य के वा वीरस्य पृष्ठतः॥६६॥
verses.english: Who were they that protected the right wheel of the ruler of the Madras in battle? Who protected the left wheel of that hero when he went to battle? Who also protected his rear?

verses.sanskrit: कथं च वः समेतानां मद्रराजो महारथः। निहतः पाण्डवैः सङ्ख्ये पुत्रो वा मम सञ्जय॥६७॥
ब्रूहि सर्वं यथातत्त्वं भरतानां महाक्षयम्। यथा च निहतः सङ्ख्ये पुत्रो दुर्योधनो मम॥६८॥
पञ्चालानां यथा सर्वे निहताः सपदानुगाः। धृष्टद्युम्नः शिखण्डी च द्रौपद्याः पञ्च चात्मजाः॥६९॥
पाण्डवाश्च यथा मुक्तास्तथोभौ माधवौ युधि। कृपश्च कृतवर्मा च भारद्वाजस्य चात्मजः॥७०॥
verses.english: Tell me how the (five) Pandavas and the two Satvatas (viz., Krishna and Satyaki) and Kripa and Kritavarman and Drona's son, have escaped with life.

verses.sanskrit: यद्यथा यादृशं चैव युद्धं वृत्तं च साम्प्रतम्। अखिलं श्रोतुमिच्छामि कुशलो ह्यसि सञ्जय॥७१॥
